project.name: masterminds-workshop
project.description: Workshop and event management site built with Next.js for Masterminds HQ

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API endpoint that creates Stripe checkout sessions for event registrations, handling request validation, pricing calculations, and sending confirmation emails.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles extensive form validation, Stripe integration, and email notifications for event registrations.

nodes.name: EventPageView.tsx
nodes.summary: Main event page component rendering dynamic event details including story sections, checklists, testimonials, hosts, and call-to-action with pricing.
nodes.languageNotes: Large component with 17 internal functions handling multiple section types; uses dynamic section rendering pattern.

nodes.name: EventRegistrationSection.tsx
nodes.summary: React component providing event registration form with Stripe Elements checkout integration, promo code handling, and success confirmation.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateful component using 17 useState hooks; implements animated counter, Stripe embedded checkout fallback, and complex form validation flow.

nodes.name: event-checkout.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for event checkout processing including checkout mode selection, amount calculation with discounts, and Stripe session parameter building.

nodes.name: events.tsx
nodes.summary: Core event data definitions and utility functions for pricing calculations, promo code resolution, and event queries across the application.
nodes.languageNotes: Large file (1402 lines) containing event data structure and helper functions; mix of hardcoded event data and reusable query utilities.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Main API handler that processes event registration requests, validates inputs, calculates final pricing with promos, creates Stripe checkout sessions, and triggers confirmation emails.

nodes.name: EventPageView
nodes.summary: Primary export component that renders the complete event page layout, coordinates all sections, and manages pricing display and registration UI.

nodes.name: StorySection
nodes.summary: Section component rendering narrative story content with subtitle support.

nodes.name: ChecklistSection
nodes.summary: Section component displaying numbered checklist items with styled counter badges.

nodes.name: CardsSection
nodes.summary: Section component displaying multiple cards with icons, titles, and bullet-point lists in flexible column layout.

nodes.name: SplitSection
nodes.summary: Section component rendering two-column layout with left-aligned text content and right-aligned image.

nodes.name: ImageSection
nodes.summary: Section component for full-width responsive images with optional captions and alt text.

nodes.name: HtmlSection
nodes.summary: Section component rendering custom HTML content with dynamic styling based on event status.

nodes.name: QuoteCardSection
nodes.summary: Section component displaying testimonial cards with author photos, quotes, media elements, and structured testimonial data.

nodes.name: HostsSection
nodes.summary: Section component showcasing event hosts with photos, names, titles, and biographical information.

nodes.name: EventVideoSection
nodes.summary: Section component embedding and playing event video with responsive sizing.

nodes.name: CtaSection
nodes.summary: Call-to-action section displaying event details, pricing with promo discounts, date/time information, and registration button.

nodes.name: renderSection
nodes.summary: Helper function that routes section data to appropriate component renderer based on section type.

nodes.name: useAnimatedNumber
nodes.summary: Custom React hook animating numeric changes using requestAnimationFrame with ease-out easing function.

nodes.name: EventRegistrationSection
nodes.summary: Main registration component managing form state, Stripe Elements checkout integration, promo code application, and success/error handling.

nodes.name: resolveCheckoutMode
nodes.summary: Determines appropriate Stripe checkout mode based on embedded checkout capability.

nodes.name: resolveEventCheckoutAmount
nodes.summary: Calculates final checkout amount after applying promo code discounts and optional donation additions.

nodes.name: buildEventCheckoutSessionParams
nodes.summary: Constructs complete Stripe checkout session parameters including line items, metadata, customer details, and success/cancel URLs.

nodes.name: getEventDiscountedPrice
nodes.summary: Wrapper function calculating event price after applying promotional discount.

nodes.name: resolvePromoCode
nodes.summary: Looks up promo code object from event pricing by case-insensitive code matching.

nodes.name: formatEventPrice
nodes.summary: Formats event price as currency string with appropriate decimal precision.

nodes.name: getEventBySlug
nodes.summary: Finds an event from the master events list by URL slug.

nodes.name: getLiveEvents
nodes.summary: Returns all events marked as live from the master events list.

nodes.name: getUpcomingLiveEvents
nodes.summary: Filters live events that end at or after a given timestamp and sorts by start date.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Handles Stripe webhook events for checkout completion, verifying signatures and triggering event confirmation notifications server-side to ensure checkout data mirrors to the database regardless of client browser state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Stripe webhook signature verification to ensure authenticity of incoming events from Stripe servers.

nodes.name: calendar.ts
nodes.summary: Generates Google Calendar and iCalendar (iCal) format strings and URLs for embedding event details in email confirmations and enabling attendees to add events to their calendar applications.

nodes.name: event-confirmation-email.ts
nodes.summary: Builds and sends transactional emails for event lifecycle management including confirmations, reminders, location notifications, and waitlist operations using Resend API with dynamic HTML templates and calendar attachments.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive HTML email generation with iCal attachments; coordinates multiple email variants for different event stages and attendee states.

nodes.name: stripe.ts
nodes.summary: Provides Stripe API client initialization and configuration, exposing environment variable accessors for the Stripe secret key and creating authenticated Stripe instances for server-side operations.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Route handler processing incoming Stripe webhook events, validating signatures, extracting checkout data, and coordinating event confirmation emails and payment finalization.

nodes.name: buildGoogleCalendarUrl
nodes.summary: Constructs a Google Calendar add-event URL from event parameters, enabling attendees to quickly import event details with one click.

nodes.name: buildIcalString
nodes.summary: Generates a complete iCalendar (RFC 5545) formatted string from event parameters including organizer, attendee, dates, and location for calendar system compatibility.

nodes.name: buildEventCalendarDescription
nodes.summary: Formats event details into a readable description string for inclusion in calendar event entries, combining title, speaker, host contact, and participation details.

nodes.name: buildAiContentCreationSetupEmailHtml
nodes.summary: Generates HTML email template for the AI Content Creation setup workflow, providing instructions and branded presentation for onboarding attendees.

nodes.name: buildAskAnAiExpertWelcomeEmailHtml
nodes.summary: Generates welcome email template for the Ask An AI Expert event, including session details, Zoom link, calendar buttons, and unsubscribe information.

nodes.name: buildConfirmationEmailHtml
nodes.summary: Builds comprehensive event confirmation email with calendar integration, location details (possibly hidden until reveal window), parking instructions, and host contact information.

nodes.name: buildLocationReminderEmailHtml
nodes.summary: Generates location reminder email template revealing the exact event address and parking instructions when the reveal window closes.

nodes.name: buildConfirmationIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Creates a deterministic idempotency key for event confirmation emails to prevent duplicate sends.

nodes.name: buildWaitlistJoinIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Creates a deterministic idempotency key for waitlist join confirmation emails.

nodes.name: buildAiContentCreationSetupIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Creates a deterministic idempotency key for AI Content Creation setup workflow emails.

nodes.name: buildAskAnAiExpertWelcomeIdempotencyKey
nodes.summary: Creates a deterministic idempotency key for Ask An AI Expert welcome emails.

nodes.name: sendEventConfirmationEmail
nodes.summary: Sends event confirmation email via Resend API, including HTML content, iCalendar attachment, and idempotency controls for transaction guarantees.

nodes.name: sendAiContentCreationSetupEmail
nodes.summary: Sends AI Content Creation setup workflow email via Resend with HTML template and idempotency key for duplicate prevention.

nodes.name: sendAskAnAiExpertWelcomeEmail
nodes.summary: Sends Ask An AI Expert welcome email with event details, iCalendar attachment, and unsubscribe headers for CAN-SPAM compliance.

nodes.name: sendEventLocationReminderEmail
nodes.summary: Sends location reminder email revealing exact address and parking details when the reveal window closes, with updated iCalendar attachment.

nodes.name: sendSessionReminderEmail
nodes.summary: Sends session reminder email to attendees with customizable time window labels (e.g., 24 hours before, same day) for various reminder triggers.

nodes.name: sendWaitlistConfirmationEmail
nodes.summary: Sends confirmation email to users when they join an event waitlist, including removal option and branded presentation.

nodes.name: sendWaitlistSpotNotificationEmail
nodes.summary: Sends notification to waitlist members when a spot opens up, with variant-specific messaging and registration link.

nodes.name: getStripeSecretKey
nodes.summary: Retrieves Stripe secret key from environment variables, supporting both production and test keys with fallback logic.

nodes.name: getStripePublishableKey
nodes.summary: Retrieves Stripe publishable key from environment variables, supporting both prefixed and non-prefixed variable names.

nodes.name: createStripeClient
nodes.summary: Instantiates and returns a Stripe client with the secret key, throwing an error if the key is not configured.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Project-specific Claude instructions for using GitNexus code intelligence tools, including requirements for impact analysis, change detection, and safe refactoring workflows.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown document with structured sections and tables; emphasizes safety guardrails for code modifications.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package configuration for the masterminds-workshop project, specifying Next.js 16, React 19, Stripe, Supabase, and animation libraries for an event registration platform.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON configuration with 20+ production dependencies including React, Stripe, Supabase, and animation libraries (Three.js, Vanta, GSAP, Framer Motion); targets Node 24.x.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration with strict mode enabled, ESNext module output, path aliases (@/* pointing to src/), and Next.js plugin integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Next.js TypeScript config with strict mode, path aliases, and incremental compilation enabled for faster builds.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration with domain-based rewrites for subdomain routing (decks.mastermindshq.business, passiveincome.mastermindshq.business) and six scheduled cron jobs for email automation and event management.
nodes.languageNotes: Vercel JSON schema with rewrites using host-based routing and crons scheduling automated tasks every 30 minutes for event reminders and abandoned checkout followups.

layers.name: Configuration & Build
layers.description: Project configuration, build tooling, and deployment settings. Includes TypeScript configuration, package dependencies, Vercel deployment config, and development documentation.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: HTTP request handlers for external integrations. Handles event checkout session creation, Stripe webhook processing, and payment event coordination.

layers.name: UI Component Layer
layers.description: React components for rendering user interface. Includes event page rendering, registration forms, dynamic section rendering, and checkout UI integration.

layers.name: Business Logic & Data Layer
layers.description: Core application logic for event data management, pricing calculations, and checkout processing. Contains event definitions, promo code resolution, pricing utilities, and checkout parameter building.

layers.name: Integration Services Layer
layers.description: Third-party service integrations and external APIs. Handles Stripe API configuration, calendar event generation (Google Calendar and iCal formats), and transactional email delivery via Resend.

tour.title: Project Foundation & Configuration
tour.description: Start by understanding the project structure and build configuration. This step covers the package metadata, Next.js configuration (including routing/redirects), TypeScript setup, and Tailwind CSS theme. These files establish the foundation for the entire application.

tour.title: Environment & Type Definitions
tour.description: Understand the TypeScript type system and development setup. This covers auto-generated type definitions, path aliases (@/* => ./src/*), and the Claude Code configuration for automation hooks. Essential for understanding how TypeScript and Next.js work together in this project.

tour.title: Page Structure & Routing
tour.description: Examine the main page layouts and routing structure. The root layout defines the global page structure. Giveaway quiz pages demonstrate dynamic routing for lead magnets and engagement.

tour.title: API Endpoints & Request Handlers
tour.description: Explore the backend API routes that power the application. This includes checkout sessions, event reminders, authentication flows, and lead magnet subscriptions. These endpoints handle user interactions like event registration and email subscriptions.

tour.title: UI Components & Rendering
tour.description: Understand the reusable React components that render the user interface. The EventPageView renders dynamic event sections (hero, checklist, video, CTA). EventRegistrationSection handles the checkout form with Stripe integration, promo codes, and confirmation modals.

tour.title: Business Logic & Data Utilities
tour.description: Dive into the core business logic libraries that power events, checkout, email, and subscriptions. These utilities handle pricing calculations, email template generation, Stripe integration, lead magnet processing, and calendar integration.

tour.title: Integration & External Services
tour.description: Understand how the application integrates with external services like Stripe, Google Calendar, and Resend email service. These modules provide guards, wrappers, and utilities for payment processing, calendar invitations, and email delivery.

tour.title: Documentation & Developer Tools
tour.description: Review the project documentation and Claude Code integration guidelines. These files help developers understand code intelligence tools (GitNexus), impact analysis, and project conventions for this workshop site.
